run_local_benchmark: run benchmarks on localhost using LocalBench with configurable node and bench parameters
run_remote_benchmark: run benchmarks on AWS using Bench with configurable faults, nodes, and rate parameters
create_instances: create a testbed by provisioning N cloud instances via InstanceManager
plot_performance: plot performance results from benchmark logs using Ploter with configurable node and latency parameters
parse_logs: parse and summarize benchmark logs from a directory using LogParser
